_readme: Which foreign set an English set came from.
This is NOT one to one and that is the interesting part. An English set is
often two Japanese sets merged: Mega Evolution (188 cards) is Mega Symphonia
plus Mega Brave (92 + 92). Some English sets have no single parent at all.
So every entry lists an ARRAY of sources.
HOW EACH ONE WAS CHECKED, because a wrong equivalence on a reference page is
a confident lie: the id pattern (M5 -> ME05), the card counts being close
with English slightly higher, and the Japanese set preceding the English one.
Where those three agree the entry is `confirmed`. Where only some agree it is
Sources are TCGdex ids. Japanese: https://api.tcgdex.net/v2/ja/sets
Korean and Chinese coverage currently stops at the Scarlet & Violet era, so
there are no Mega Evolution entries for those languages yet.
DO NOT add an entry from a card-site article. Check it against the counts.

mega-evolution.note: Two Japanese sets merged into one English release: 92 plus 92 cards against 188.

ascended-heroes.note: A high-pull subset in Japan, which is why both sides are unusually large.
